settingsSessions.autoApprove.name: Auto-approve trivial steps
settingsSessions.autoApprove.desc: Skip approval gates for low-risk phases
settingsSessions.compactAt.name: Compact Claude context at (tokens)
settingsSessions.compactAt.desc: Claude sessions and tasks compact the conversation by themselves once the context reaches about this size. 0 = Claude's own default (near the model's window). Claude clamps this to 100k–1M.
settingsSessions.autoContinueBg.name: Auto-continue after background task
settingsSessions.autoContinueBg.desc: When a background command (Bash run_in_background) finishes and the session is idle, continue the turn automatically. Off = show a “Continue” prompt instead. Claude sessions always continue on their own: Claude starts the reply the moment the task finishes.
settingsSessions.pasteAsFile.name: Paste as file
settingsSessions.pasteAsFile.desc: Long pasted text becomes an attachment instead of inline content
settingsSessions.pasteThreshold.name: Paste threshold (chars)
settingsSessions.pasteThreshold.desc: Paste longer than this becomes a file (200–100000)
settingsSessions.context.heading: Context injection
settingsSessions.context.agentsCatalog.d: Send the catalogue of agents you can delegate to with every turn. Off still lets the model delegate — it just isn't handed the menu up front. Claude models load their agents natively, so this applies to other providers only.
settingsSessions.context.skillsCatalog.d: Send the catalogue of skills with every turn. Off still lets you point at one with @skill — only the listing is dropped. Claude models load their skills natively, so this applies to other providers only.
settingsSessions.quota.heading: Usage quota (5-hour limit)
settingsSessions.quota.warning.name: Quota warning
settingsSessions.quota.warning.desc: Warn when the account's 5-hour usage limit reaches the threshold
settingsSessions.quota.threshold.name: Threshold (%)
settingsSessions.quota.threshold.desc: Warn at this percentage of the account's 5-hour usage limit (50–99)
settingsSessions.quota.abort.name: Abort sessions on threshold
settingsSessions.quota.abort.desc: Destructive: cancels the account's running sessions when its 5-hour limit hits the threshold
settingsSessions.quota.blockNew.name: Block on threshold
settingsSessions.quota.blockNew.desc: Prevent new sessions AND new messages on an account once its 5-hour limit hits the threshold
